title_zh: 安排新队员的训练支持

scenario.label_zh: 为新队员安排名单核对和团队支持
scenario.goal_zh: 确认新队员已在名单中并约定由队长接待并解释热身

context_zh: 成年业余篮球队队长 Ellis 与教练 Wen 安排新队员 Sam 的球队训练支持。
author: author-phase12-a

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: Is Sam on the roster for Saturday's training now?

sentences.speaker: Wen
sentences.text: Yes. It's Sam's first season in the league, so remember what it feels like to be a rookie.

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: Could we rally around Sam without making a big public fuss?

sentences.speaker: Wen
sentences.text: That sounds good. Would you meet Sam at the door and explain the warm-up?

sentences.speaker: Ellis
sentences.text: I will. I'll keep it friendly and let Sam ask questions at their own pace.

targets.sense_zh: 新手；初次参加某类活动的人
